```{r}
#| label: packages
#| message: false
# Packages used should be installed before loading
library("tidyverse")
library("readxl")
library("here")
```

#### Loading the files into tibbles

```{r}
#| message: false
Data_Set_1 <- read_excel(
  here("data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_1.xlsx"))

Data_Set_2 <- read_excel(
  here("data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_2.xlsx"))

Data_Set_3 <- read_excel(
  here("data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_3.xlsx"), sheet = "table")

Data_Set_4 <- read_excel(
  here("data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_4.xlsx"))

Data_Set_5 <- read_excel(
  here("data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_5.xlsx"))
```

#### Inspection step for logical loading and subsequent saving

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| warning: false
head(Data_Set_1, 10)

head(Data_Set_2, 10)

head(Data_Set_3, 10)

head(Data_Set_4, 10)

head(Data_Set_5, 10)
```

#### Upon observing the excel file structure we can skip the some lines made for excel-visual-aid

```{r}
#| message: false
Data_Set_1 <- read_excel(
  here("data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_1.xlsx"), skip = 9)

Data_Set_5 <- read_excel(
  here("data/_raw/tpc119453_Supplemental_Data_Set_5.xlsx"), skip = 5)
```

#### Look at the structure for sanity check

```{r}
#| eval: false
head(Data_Set_1, 10)

head(Data_Set_5, 10)
```

#### Save the workable files in data/ folder

```{r}
write_csv(Data_Set_1, file = "../data/data_set1.csv")
write_csv(Data_Set_5, file = "../data/data_set5.csv")
```

#### Make Data Set 1 Readable

```{r}
Data_Set1 <- read_csv("../data/data_set1.csv", show_col_types = F)
Data_Set1 <- Data_Set1 |> 
  
  # find the first 8 columns 
  select(matches("\\.\\.\\.[1-8]$")) |> 
  
  rename("Gene_ID" = "...1",
         "Description" = "...2",
         "AC_G" = "G...3",
         "AC_P" = "P...4",
         "TF18_G" = "G...5",
         "TF18_P" = "P...6",
         "rin_G" = "G...7",
         "rin_P" = "P...8") |> 
  
  # set Gene_ID as a factor for later plotting
  mutate(Gene_ID = as_factor(Gene_ID))
```

#### Make Data Set 5 Readable

```{r}
Data_Set5 <- read_csv("../data/data_set5.csv", show_col_types = F)
head(Data_Set5) |> 
  rename("Description" = )
```
